text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 1.5% in the last day, with altcoins following suit, signaling a mild pullback rather than panic selling. Fear & Greed remains in greed territory at 67 but has declined 7 points over a week, suggesting confidence is cooling slightly as prices consolidate. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 58.7% with $108B in daily volume indicates traders are rotating cautiously rather than fleeing risk entirely.
